THE TRAINER’S FIELD GUIDE

Know your ground.

01

Move, then make your move.

A/D moves, W jumps. Each turn gives 125 movement points and one attack. A jump costs 18. Pick a partner with 1–6, then Q/E to choose its move.

02

Aim with confidence.

Click the field to aim or use the sliders. Flip direction with F. Dots show the predicted arc; a ring marks the impact. Power changes lobs and Heavy Slam, not beams. Space commits the attack.

03

Change the battlefield.

Boulder opens huge craters. Hydro Pump pushes. Thunderbolt stops at cover. Ghost attacks pass through it. Rock Wall builds cover. Dig tunnels. Heavy Slam leaps to its marker.

04

Find a combination.

Water wets for two enemy turns and extinguishes burns. Electricity deals 50% more to wet trainers. Fire burns for 4 HP on each of two turns. Curse halves the rival’s next movement budget. Strong moves need a turn or two to recharge.

Trainers have 140 HP. Falls can hurt; the sea is fatal. Blast damage fades with distance and is reduced by solid cover. Pokémon are summoned attackers and do not take damage in Trainer Battle.
